dialogue: Weh, new year new me konon. Jom lepak mamak malam ni, cite sikit azam korang pe citer? Aku azam tahun ni nak glow up je giler.
Bapak ah, esok Valentine?! Aku lupa gila nak beli hadiah do! Mampus la kena marah esok, rasa macam nak lari gi ostolia je baii!! Tolong aa wei nak beli apa ni?!!

Guys! I just found the absolute BEST hiking trail in Bukit Kiara! The view is incredible, the elevation is just perfect for a morning sweat, and I've already mapped out the whole route for us. We MUST go this weekend, I'll bring healthy snacks!
Bazar mana gempak hari ni? Aku dengar murtabak kat TTDI tu beratur panjang do. Nak try usha tapi malas sial nak redah jem. Korang ada port baek tak?
Aaaaa kenapa deadline semua kumpul satu minggu ni?! Laptop aku pulak buat hal time ni la nak update Windows. Aku rasa nak campak je laptop ni dari tingkat 4!!

Okay team, I've compiled a 10-page itinerary for our trip to Penang next month! I've color-coded the cafes based on Google Review ratings and calculated the exact driving distance between each food stop. It's going to be EPIC!
Weh jom layan movie malam ni, dengar cite cerita baru tu gempak gila. Korang belanja popcorn, aku beli tiket. On x on?
Wei Merdeka wei! Nak pergi Dataran tapi terbangun lambat la pulak!! Jalan semua dah tutup, aku sangkut kat traffic light dah setengah jam. Agak-agak sempat tak ni?!

Have you guys seen the specs on the new phone drop?! The new camera sensor is exactly what I've been waiting for! I already pre-ordered the max spec version. I can't wait to do an unboxing review for you guys!
Korang, tiket konsert dah nak sold out dowh! Sape yang belum beli cepat sikit. Kalau melepas ni memang rugi teruk baii, line-up dia sumpah lit gila!
Asal hujan memanjang ni?! Dah la baju aku tak kering lagi dari minggu lepas. Lepastu kasut aku masuk lecah pulak tadi, aduhh bala betul la hari ni, sumpah aku nak tidur je setahun!

What an amazing year it has been! I've achieved 8 out of my 10 goals, read 25 books, and learned so much! I'm already drafting my vision board for next year and it's looking brighter than ever. Let's finish the year strong, guys!
